name: setup
oneLiner: Runs once after each build and each restart, before the first draw. Optional: whatever it returns is passed to draw as data.
signatures: function setup({width, height, resolution, duration, floats, textures})

name: draw
oneLiner: Runs once a step, 60 times a second while the animation plays, to draw on the canvas.
signatures: function draw(ctx, {time, frame, duration, width, height, resolution, floats, textures, data})

name: ctx
oneLiner: The canvas's 2D drawing context, scaled so the canvas is 1080 units tall.

name: time
oneLiner: The time of this step, in seconds, the same as iTime.

name: frame
oneLiner: The step number, the same as iFrame. It goes back to 0 when the layer restarts.

name: duration
oneLiner: The length of the animation, in seconds.

name: width
oneLiner: The canvas's width in canvas units: 1920 for 16:9, as the canvas is 1080 units tall.

name: height
oneLiner: The canvas's height in canvas units, always 1080.

name: resolution
oneLiner: The frame's size in pixels, [width, height], the same as iResolution. height / resolution[1] is one pixel in canvas units.

name: floats
oneLiner: The 16 timeline values at this time: floats[0] is iFloat0.

name: textures
oneLiner: The 8 texture slots, ready for ctx.drawImage, or null for an empty slot. A video's slot holds its frame at this step's time.

name: data
oneLiner: Whatever setup returned. Only draw gets it.

name: drawList
oneLiner: Draws a nested list of commands with y up from -1 to 1, like a shader's uv. view shows another part of the plane.
signatures: drawList(ctx, list, view = {xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax})

name: clear
oneLiner: Clears the whole canvas to transparent, or to a colour.

name: seededRandom
oneLiner: A function that returns random numbers from 0 up to 1, the same ones each time for the same seed.

name: Set
oneLiner: Sets the context's properties for the rest of its list. lineDash takes an array. new Set() is still JavaScript's Set.
signatures: Set({fillStyle, strokeStyle, lineWidth, font, globalAlpha, lineDash, ...})

name: Disk
oneLiner: A filled circle, or its outline with edge: true and fill: false. Angles draw an arc; sector joins its ends to the centre.
signatures: Disk({center = [0, 0], radius = 1, fill = true, edge = false, startAngle = 0, endAngle = 2π, sector = false, radiusInPixels = false})

name: Polygon
oneLiner: A filled shape through the points, like [[0, 0], [1, 0], [0, 1]].

name: Line
oneLiner: A line through the points. closed joins the last point to the first.

name: Text
oneLiner: Text at a point in the current font, upright and the same size whatever the list's scale.
signatures: Text({at = [0, 0], text, align, baseline, fill = true, edge = false})

name: Rotate
oneLiner: Turns what follows in its list anticlockwise by angle radians, about center.

name: Translate
oneLiner: Moves what follows in its list by offset, like [0.5, 0].

name: Scale
oneLiner: Makes what follows in its list bigger or smaller about center. scaleX and scaleY scale one direction.
signatures: Scale({scale = 1, scaleX = scale, scaleY = scale, center = [0, 0]})

name: AbsoluteLineWidth
oneLiner: Sets the line width in canvas units, whatever the list's scale. Lines in a drawList start 2 units wide.

name: fillRect
oneLiner: Fills a rectangle with the fill style.

name: strokeRect
oneLiner: Outlines a rectangle with the stroke style and line width.

name: clearRect
oneLiner: Makes a rectangle transparent.

name: fillText
oneLiner: Draws text at a point, in the current font and fill style.

name: strokeText
oneLiner: Outlines text at a point, in the current font and stroke style.

name: measureText
oneLiner: Measures text in the current font: measureText(text).width is how wide it is.

name: beginPath
oneLiner: Starts a new path, forgetting the last one.

name: closePath
oneLiner: Joins the path's current point back to its start.

name: moveTo
oneLiner: Starts a new piece of the path at a point.

name: lineTo
oneLiner: Adds a straight line to a point to the path.

name: arc
oneLiner: Adds a circular arc to the path. Angles are in radians, clockwise from the x axis as y goes down.
signatures: ctx.arc(x, y, radius, startAngle, endAngle, counterclockwise)

name: ellipse
oneLiner: Adds an elliptical arc to the path.
signatures: ctx.ellipse(x, y, radiusX, radiusY, rotation, startAngle, endAngle)

name: rect
oneLiner: Adds a rectangle to the path.

name: quadraticCurveTo
oneLiner: Adds a quadratic Bézier curve to the path.

name: bezierCurveTo
oneLiner: Adds a cubic Bézier curve to the path.
signatures: ctx.bezierCurveTo(cp1x, cp1y, cp2x, cp2y, x, y)

name: fill
oneLiner: Fills the path with the fill style.

name: stroke
oneLiner: Outlines the path with the stroke style and line width.

name: clip
oneLiner: Limits drawing to inside the path, until restore.

name: save
oneLiner: Remembers the styles, transform and clip, for restore to bring back.

name: restore
oneLiner: Brings back the styles, transform and clip from the last save.

name: translate
oneLiner: Moves the origin of what's drawn next.

name: rotate
oneLiner: Turns what's drawn next clockwise by angle radians, about the origin.

name: scale
oneLiner: Scales what's drawn next, about the origin.

name: setTransform
oneLiner: Replaces the transform. The canvas starts each draw scaled to 1080 units tall.
signatures: ctx.setTransform(a, b, c, d, e, f)

name: drawImage
oneLiner: Draws an image, like one of textures, optionally scaled or cropped.
signatures: ctx.drawImage(image, sx, sy, sWidth, sHeight, dx, dy, dWidth, dHeight)

name: setLineDash
oneLiner: Makes lines dashed, with lengths of dashes and gaps. An empty array makes them solid.

name: createLinearGradient
oneLiner: A gradient along a line, for fillStyle or strokeStyle. Add colours with addColorStop.

name: createRadialGradient
oneLiner: A gradient between two circles, for fillStyle or strokeStyle. Add colours with addColorStop.
signatures: ctx.createRadialGradient(x0, y0, r0, x1, y1, r1)

name: fillStyle
oneLiner: The colour, gradient or pattern that fills shapes and text, like "orange" or "#ffcc00".

name: strokeStyle
oneLiner: The colour, gradient or pattern of lines and outlines.

name: lineWidth
oneLiner: The width of lines, in the current coordinates. It starts at 2 canvas units.

name: lineCap
oneLiner: How lines end: "butt", "round" or "square".

name: lineJoin
oneLiner: How lines meet at corners: "miter", "round" or "bevel".

name: font
oneLiner: The text's size, font and optional weight, like "600 64px Inter". It starts as 48px Inter.

name: textAlign
oneLiner: Where text sits across from its point: "left", "center", "right", "start" or "end".

name: textBaseline
oneLiner: Where text sits up and down from its point: "alphabetic", "top", "middle", "bottom"…

name: globalAlpha
oneLiner: How opaque what's drawn next is, from 0 to 1.

name: globalCompositeOperation
oneLiner: How what's drawn next mixes with the canvas: "source-over" as usual, "lighter" to add, "destination-out" to rub out…

name: shadowBlur
oneLiner: How blurred shadows are. Shadows show once shadowColor is set.

name: shadowColor
oneLiner: The colour of shadows, which are off while it's transparent.

name: filter
oneLiner: A CSS filter for what's drawn next, like "blur(4px)".
